scope: File-level recheck of two frequently cited real-world HRS sources for an independent station-to-vehicle holdout

sources.title: Existing Light-Duty Hydrogen Refueling Stations In-Use Study Report
sources.reported_scope: HyStEP in-use performance and fault/communication tests at 22 California light-duty HRS sites; Appendix A states that study results were tabulated in an Excel workbook.

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The report exposes pass/fail matrices, protocol context and selected plots, but the referenced Excel workbook and synchronized station-to-vehicle rows were not publicly linked or downloadable from the report page during the file-level recheck.

sources.next_action: Request the Appendix A workbook plus raw HyStEP channels, units, calibration/quality flags and written permission for derived publication.

sources.title: Hydrogen refueling stations and fuel cell buses four year operational analysis under real-world conditions
sources.reported_scope: Five European 350-bar bus HRS sites, with multi-year operator logs summarized by filling amount, duration, average flow, daily profile, utilization and availability.

public_artifact_inspection.operator_log_detail: The E3S paper describes daily/monthly logbook fields such as date/time, kilograms per fill and duration; dynamic pressure-temperature-flow rows are not published.
public_artifact_inspection.project_documentation: The public 3Emotion Description of Work assigns predefined Excel sheets and refilled-hydrogen information to bus/station operators; it does not release the operator workbooks.
public_artifact_inspection.finding: This is credible real-station operational provenance and an actionable data-request route, but the public artifacts contain aggregate logbook results rather than an untouched synchronized station-to-vehicle pressure/temperature/mass-flow archive.

sources.next_action: Request de-identified event/time-series exports from the 3Emotion station operators or authors with channel definitions, capacity/protocol metadata and reuse terms.

claim_boundary: Neither source closes the independent full-loop numerical gate. A report-referenced workbook, aggregate logbook, plot or paper is not promoted to validation until synchronized raw files, immutable hashes, frozen scoring protocol and written reuse rights are available.
